(2) Deciding source: a 2002 Mouton monograph by the field's principal grammarian of the older-futhark corpus -- authoritative, but the stress rule is inferential (PGmc root accent 'in ALL cases' + root=stressed/nonroot=unstressed + stressed-root parsing of runic alawin), which is the only kind of evidence an epigraphic language of AD 150-700 can offer.
